definitions.gloss: transcendent; extraordinary; far surpassing the ordinary
definitions.explanation: Describes something that goes far beyond normal levels. Used both in formal/literary contexts and in casual modern speech as an intensifier.

examples.japanese: {超絶|ちょうぜつ}{技巧|ぎこう}のピアニスト。
あの{店|みせ}のラーメンは{超絶|ちょうぜつ}うまい。
examples.english: The ramen at that place is insanely good.

examples.japanese: {超絶|ちょうぜつ}した{演奏|えんそう}{技術|ぎじゅつ}で{観客|かんきゃく}を{魅了|みりょう}した。
examples.english: The audience was captivated by the extraordinary performance technique.

notes:
Has two distinct registers. In classical/formal usage, {超絶|ちょうぜつ} means genuinely transcendent (going beyond worldly things, as in philosophy or virtuoso music). In modern casual speech, it functions as a trendy intensifier similar to {超|ちょう} but stronger, meaning "insanely" or "ridiculously."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {超絶|ちょうぜつ}{技巧|ぎこう}: transcendent technique (often for music)
- {超絶|ちょうぜつ}うまい: insanely delicious (casual)
- {超絶|ちょうぜつ}{可愛|かわい}い: ridiculously cute (casual)
- {超絶|ちょうぜつ}した: transcendent, extraordinary (literary)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {超|ちょう}: super, very (casual prefix intensifier, lighter)
- {卓越|たくえつ}した: outstanding, preeminent (formal)
- {抜群|ばつぐん}: outstanding, exceptional (common praise word)
